goals: Let ordinary cartographers offer a dedicated explorer map that locates the Ribbits village structure in the Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric stack.
Preserve Ribbits villages, vanilla swamp huts, and Matcha's existing swamp-hut explorer map as distinct structures and discovery paths.
scope: Begin implementation only after the Ribbits 26.2 port has a runtime-functional candidate whose exact village structure identity and world-generation behavior can be verified.
Audit the then-current Minecraft 26.2 explorer-map, structure-tag, villager-trade, and Matcha swamp-hut-map contracts, then use the narrowest server-authoritative Fabric compatibility implementation.

Add a non-replacing later-tier offer to ordinary cartographers for a translatable Ribbit Village Explorer Map; determine the exact tier, ingredients, emerald cost, uses, experience, and search radius only after comparing the existing Matcha trade table.
Target only the registered Ribbits village structure or a dedicated compatibility-owned structure tag, without copying, renaming, replacing, or redistributing Ribbits structure data.
Use a distinct, non-misleading map name and destination marker presentation, with only original or vanilla-compatible resources if a new decoration asset is required.

Preserve independent Ribbits village spawning, vanilla swamp-hut spawning, existing cartographer offers, villager restocking, map persistence, save/reload behavior, and dedicated-server compatibility.

exclusions: Implementation source, build files, generated resources, artifacts, Canary versions, and speculative scaffolding while the project remains PLANNED.
Replacing swamp huts with Ribbits villages, suppressing either structure's independent world generation, sharing one structure identity, or repurposing the existing swamp-hut explorer map.
Changes to the Ribbits 26.2 port, its protected All Rights Reserved resources, its private artifact, YUNG's API, Matcha's unrelated content, or any other project.

A general villager-trade overhaul, general explorer-map framework, structure-frequency rebalance, guaranteed-nearby village generation, or changes to vanilla cartographer progression beyond the dedicated compatibility offer.
Copying or redistributing protected Ribbits textures, icons, structure templates, data, or other private material.
Deployment, Test Slot occupancy, Minecraft launch, runtime-state mutation, protected gameplay-instance access, or runtime-validation claims during project initialization.

dependencies.requirement: A runtime-functional Minecraft 26.2 Ribbits release with a verified registered village structure identity.
dependencies.reason: The compatibility map must locate the canonical Ribbits village without modifying or duplicating the base port's world-generation content.
Exact game target whose villager-trade, explorer-map, map-decoration, structure-tag, and locate contracts must be used.
Current Minecraft 26.2 Fabric loader baseline for a separate compatibility mod.
Current Fabric API baseline; the implementation must use supported trade or lifecycle hooks where available and remain server-authoritative.

dependencies.requirement: Current Minecraft 26.2 Workbench stack containing the existing swamp-hut explorer-map offer; exact supplying component and version to be audited before implementation.
dependencies.reason: The new Ribbits trade must coexist with Matcha's current swamp-hut discovery path without replacing, renaming, or crowding it out.

state.milestone: Official PLANNED project initialized for a dedicated cartographer-sold Ribbit Village Explorer Map. Ribbits villages and swamp huts remain separate structures with separate explorer maps; implementation is deferred until the Ribbits 26.2 port is runtime-functional and the exact Matcha trade and structure contracts are audited.
